title: Big AI teams up with Big Government
text:
“People of the same trade seldom meet together,” warned Adam Smith 250 years ago, “even for merriment and diversion, but the conversation ends in a conspiracy against the public, or in some contrivance to raise prices.”

Today, the masters of the AI universe have combined forces, and the leaders of the Democratic Party have joined hands with this cabal. The consequences could be far worse than higher prices for your chatbot.
